_ordering_rationale: AstraZeneca = pharma global oncologie + biopharma (CVRM, R&I, V&I) + rare diseases (Alexion). KPIs ordres: Total Revenue, Oncology Sales (engine PV), CVRM Sales, Rare Disease (Alexion), Operating Profit. AZN.ST cote Stockholm = mirror du listing UK/US.

kpis.signal: Doublement post-acquisition Alexion (Q3 2021) + cycle COVID. FY25 +9% confirme par Chairman statement. FY25 valeur calculee 54,073 x 1.09
kpis.description_fr: CA total AZN (Product Sales + Alliance + Collaboration). Hypercroissance soutenue par Oncology + Rare Diseases. NOTE: la valeur FY25 inscrite ici est l'historique FY24 (54,073); FY25 implicite ~58.9 Mds.
kpis.description_en: AstraZeneca total revenue (Product + Alliance + Collaboration). Sustained hypergrowth driven by Oncology + Rare Diseases. NOTE: the value field shows FY24=54,073; FY25 implied ~58.9bn (Chair statement +9%).
kpis._caveat: FY25 actuel non publie a la date d'extraction (rapport annuel complet pas dans archives sec-data). value reflete FY24.

kpis.signal: Coeur PV AZN: oncologie quasi-double sur 5 ans. Tagrisso, Imfinzi, Lynparza, Calquence, Enhertu drives
kpis.description_fr: CA total Oncology AZN (Tagrisso, Imfinzi, Lynparza, Calquence, Enhertu, Truqap, Tagrisso). Segment #1 AZN ~37% du CA. Pipeline late-stage massive.
kpis.description_en: AZN total Oncology revenue (Tagrisso, Imfinzi, Lynparza, Calquence, Enhertu, Truqap). #1 segment, ~37% of revenue. Massive late-stage pipeline.

kpis.signal: Croissance +70% sur 5 ans portee par Farxiga (SGLT2 inhibitor): ~$7.7 Mds FY24
kpis.description_fr: CA segment CVRM (Cardiovascular, Renal, Metabolism). Engine = Farxiga (diabete/heart failure/CKD). Brilinta + Crestor + Lokelma + Wainua (TTR).
kpis.description_en: CVRM segment revenue (Cardio/Renal/Metabolism). Engine = Farxiga (diabetes/HF/CKD). Brilinta + Crestor + Lokelma + Wainua (TTR).
kpis._note: Donnees CVRM FY20=7,096 / FY21=8,020 sourcees 20-F 2022. FY22-FY24 sourcees 20-F 2024/2025 (reclassement Wainua, perimetre mineur).

kpis.signal: Joyau Alexion (acquisition 21-07-2021 pour $39 Mds). Ultomiris/Soliris franchise complement + Strensiq. Justifie le prix d'acquisition
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Rare Disease (Alexion). Acquisition Alexion finalisee Q3 2021 (contribution partielle FY21). Ultomiris croissance forte (+32% FY24), Soliris en declin (conversion vers Ultomiris).
kpis.description_en: Rare Disease segment (Alexion). Acquisition closed Q3 2021 (partial FY21 contribution). Strong Ultomiris growth (+32% FY24), Soliris declining (conversion to Ultomiris).

kpis.signal: Normalisation marges post-Alexion integration + amortissements. FY24 OP 18.5% du CA, en route vers ~25-30% structurel
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel reporte (IFRS). Repli FY21 = couts integration Alexion + amortissements PPA + COVID. Reprise forte FY22-FY24 portee par operating leverage Oncology + Rare Disease.
kpis.description_en: Reported operating profit (IFRS). FY21 dip = Alexion integration costs + PPA amortization + COVID. Strong rebound FY22-FY24 driven by Oncology + Rare Disease operating leverage.
